```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Load all libraries
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(stringr)

```

Similarities for males cluster

```{r}

data_iso <- read.csv("../results/Males_SeasonalClusters.csv")
data_iso$SeasonalClusters <- str_replace_all(data_iso$SeasonalClusters, fixed(" "), "")
data_iso[,6:8] <- scale(data_iso[,6:8]) # Scale the data

#Calculate centroids
season.centroids <- data_iso %>%
  group_by(SeasonalClusters) %>%
  summarise(across(c(d13C,d15N,StandardLength_cm),mean))

centroid_mat <- as.matrix(season.centroids[, -1])
labels <- season.centroids$SeasonalClusters

dist_mat <- dist(centroid_mat)
hc <- hclust(dist_mat)
hc$labels <- labels

plot(hc, main = 'Relationship among Clusters for Males NESE', xlab = "", sub = "")

```

PERMANOVA and pairwise distances
```{r}

dist_mat <- dist(data_iso[,6:8])
adonis2(dist_mat ~ SeasonalClusters, data = data_iso)

# Pairwise differences among clusters
pairwise.adonis(dist_mat, data_iso$SeasonalClusters)

```

Distance between centroids using vegan
```{r}
dist_mat <- dist(data_iso[,6:8])
centroid_dist <- betadisper(dist_mat, data_iso$SeasonalClusters)
distance <- dist(centroid_dist$centroids)
anova(centroid_dist) # Check dispersion

as.matrix(distance)

hc <- hclust(distance)
hc$labels <- labels

plot(hc, main = 'Relationship among Clusters for Males NESE', xlab = "", sub = "")


```

```{r}

#PCA to visualise dispersion
pca <- prcomp(data_iso[,6:8])
data_iso$SeasonalClusters <- as.factor(data_iso$SeasonalClusters)
group_levels <- levels(data_iso$SeasonalClusters)
palette <- c("red", "blue", "green", "orange", "purple", "black")

cols <- palette[as.numeric(data_iso$SeasonalClusters)]

plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2],
     col = cols,
     pch = 19)

legend("topright",
       legend = group_levels,
       col = palette,
       pch = 19)
```
